info.title: PikaNetwork Stats API
info.description:
The public API behind stats.pika-network.net. Call it from a bot, a script or a server.

**API key:** every request needs a free key in the `X-Api-Key` header. Get one in-game with `/apikey` (link your Discord first with `/linkaccount`). A missing or invalid key gets `401`. Leaked key? `/apikey reset` makes a new one.

**Rate limit:** 120 requests per minute per key. Responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (seconds); over the limit you get `429 Too Many Requests` with `Retry-After`. Cache what you can.

**What's here:** player profiles and per-mode stats with daily history, leaderboards (including the day's biggest movers), factions / islands / gangs / teams with their history, BedWars guilds, events from the events server, every PvP kill with both players' gear, past seasons and match recaps.

**Game modes** (`type`, `{mode}`): `opfactions`, `opprison`, `opskyblock`, `oneblock`, `survival`, `kitpvp`, `unrankedpractice`, `rankedpractice`, `bedwars`, `skywars`, `oplifesteal`, `skypvp`, `skymines`, `genpvp`, `wildkits`, `dungeons`.

Names from the game can contain Minecraft color codes (`§c`, `§l`, ...); strip them with `/§[0-9a-fk-or]/gi` before showing them.

This documentation is community-maintained from the API's real responses; the API itself can change without notice.

tags.name: Players
tags.description: Profiles, per-mode stats and their daily history

tags.name: Leaderboards
tags.description: Player rankings per game mode and stat, and the day's biggest movers

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Factions (OpFactions), islands (OpSkyBlock, OneBlock, SkyMines), gangs (OpPrison) and teams (KitPvP, SkyPvP, GenPvP, Survival, OpLifeSteal)

tags.name: Guilds
tags.description: BedWars guilds (called clans in the API)

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Events hosted on the events server (Spleef, Sumo, Parkour...) with everyone's final placement

tags.name: Fights

get.description: Network level, ranks per server, friends, guild and linked accounts.

404.description: No player with that name (empty body)

get.summary: A player's stats in one game mode
get.description: Every stat of the mode, keyed by its display name (`Kills`, `Final kills`, `Balance`...). Each stat has the total number of ranked players and the player's own entry with their value and leaderboard place, or `entries: null` if they have none for that period.

get.summary: A player's faction / island / gang / team in each mode

200.description: One entry per mode the player is in a group in (empty array if none)

get.summary: A player's daily progression in one mode
get.description: Their lifetime stats day by day (minigames and Practice: all modes summed), for the stats the site tracks. A day only has a point if they played; missing days carry the previous value. Stats with no data are left out.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: Comma list of stat ids (default: the mode's tracked stats)

204.description: The player keeps their stats private (empty body)

get.description: Use the stat's internal key (`wins`, `kills`, `BALANCE`, `PRISON_PRESTIGE`, `HARVEST_SUGAR_CANE`...), not its display name. Pages hold at most **25** entries; a higher `limit` is capped. BedWars entries include the player's guild in `clan`.

get.summary: Totals for every stat of a mode
get.description: How many players have each stat, plus the sum and average across all of them.

get.summary: Every stat id a mode has a board for
get.description: Use `id` as `stat=` on `/leaderboards`. `name` is the display name when known, else the id. Handy for stats per item, like each crate.

Each player's value today minus their last value on or before the start of the window. Only players who played today and gained are listed; private players are hidden. Note: `stat` is the lowercase stat id used by `/profile/{username}/history` (`common.balance`), not the leaderboard key.

parameters.name: stat
parameters.description: Lowercase stat id (default: the mode's first tracked stat)

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: `1d` = today vs yesterday, `7d` = today vs a week ago (UTC days; today is partial)

get.description: Factions, islands, gangs or teams ranked by their headline value (worth, points...). In Survival and OpLifeSteal every team has 0, so the order there is not a ranking.

parameters.name: with
parameters.description: `change` adds each group's 24-hour place and value change

get.description: Members with roles, headline value, place and the members' combined stats (`aggStats`, keyed by stat id; names in `/teams/{mode}/stats`). `breakdown` holds mode-specific details (OpFactions: worth components, allies, spawners...).

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: From `/teams/{mode}/top` or `/players/{username}/teams` (a number for factions, a UUID for islands)

get.summary: Names of a mode's team stats
get.description: Maps the stat ids used in `aggStats` to display names. Some ids that appear in `aggStats` are not listed here.
Hourly snapshots of place, headline value and every team stat, oldest first.
Without time params: both groups now. With `at` (epoch ms): each side's last snapshot at or before then. With `from` and `to`: each side's series in that span (newest 500 points).

400.description: `at` together with `from`/`to`, or only one of `from`/`to`

404.description: No guild with that name (empty body)

get.description: A BedWars guild by its exact name: tag, trophies, owner, members with join dates and level.

get.summary: A guild's members with their BedWars totals
get.description: The whole roster in one call: each member's all-time, weekly and monthly totals (all modes summed). `stats` is null for members with private stats.

parameters.name: stats
parameters.description: Comma list of BedWars stat keys, max 20

get.summary: The guild a player is in

get.description: Every finished event with its winners. Test runs and cancelled lobbies are never recorded.

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now
Fights or events are not available right now

get.description: Per player, with their latest name. Force-ended events don't count.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Only events in the last N days; 0 = all time

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now
Fights or events are not available right now

get.description: Their totals and events, newest first.

204.description: The player keeps their stats private (empty body)

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now

get.summary: The latest kills in a mode
get.description: PvP kills from the last 2 days, newest first, with both sides' rank, sets and held weapon, how long the fight took and what each side used. Players with private stats have `username: null`.

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now

get.description: Top killers, weapons, sets (kills made wearing each, and how many players wore it), consumables, death causes, the kill count and the median fight length.

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now

get.summary: One fight with both full loadouts
get.description: Every slot of both players' gear with enchants, sets, kits and scrolls, their gear when the fight began, and the in-game name and lore of each bonus item.

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now

get.description: Kills, deaths, their latest fights, head to head against the players they met most, the weapons they killed with, what they used, deaths with no player killer, per-mode totals and kill streaks.

204.description: The player keeps their stats private (empty body)

503.description: Fights or events are not available right now

get.description: Past (finished) season numbers per mode, keyed as `grizzly:{mode}`. The current season is not listed; requests without `season` return it. Some listed seasons have no data at all.
When each season of a mode started and ended. A season ends when the next one starts, so the running season has `end: null`. Seasons without a recorded start date are left out.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only this type, e.g. `grizzly:opfactions` (returns just its list)

200.description: Dates per type, oldest season first

503.description: Dates can't be read right now

get.description: The result of one game: map, duration, every player's stats and the winners. The game id comes from the recap link shown in game after a match.

interval.name: interval
interval.description: Period. `yearly` exists only for BedWars and Unranked Practice; past seasons only have `total`.

subMode.name: mode
subMode.description: Sub-mode filter: `ALL_MODES` for everything, or e.g. BedWars `SOLO`, `DOUBLES`, `TRIPLES`, `QUAD`; Practice `NODEBUFF`, `BOXING`, `SUMO`...

season.name: season
season.description: Past season number (see `/seasons`). Leave out for the current season.

RateLimited.description: Over your key's limit (120 a minute). Wait the seconds in `Retry-After` and retry.

clan.description: The player's BedWars guild, or null

value.description: Numeric value as a string (can be very large or fractional)

rank.description: Rank on that server, when the player has one

value.description: Headline value (worth, points...) as a string

placeChange24h.description: With `with=change`: places gained in 24 hours (positive = up)

valueChange24h.description: With `with=change`: headline value gained in 24 hours

role.description: Depends on the mode: LEADER, CO_LEADER, OFFICER, MODERATOR, MEMBER, RECRUIT, OWNER...

aggStats.description: Members' combined stats by stat id

end.description: The next season's start; null while running

stats.description: Stat names shown in this recap

outAt.description: Epoch ms when they went out; null for players still in at the end

username.description: Null when their stats are private

elo.description: Null where the mode has no rating

weapon.description: What they held: a material, `kit:<kit>:<material>` or a bonus item id

loadout.description: Fight pages only: their gear at the kill

consumables.description: What they used during the fight

startLoadout.description: Fight pages only: their gear when the fight began

cause.description: Damage cause of the killing blow

duration.description: Ms from when both sides were in combat to the kill

items.description: In-game name and lore of each bonus piece, by `<set>:<slot>`

indexable.description: False for a fight on a development or testing server: it answers by its id (with `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`) but is in no list

bestStreak.description: Most kills in a row without dying

opponents.description: Head to head with the players met most

deathsBy.description: Deaths with no player killer, by damage cause
